# railway_service_deploy (Resource)

Railway service deploy.

Deploys a service instance in an environment when the resource is created. Changing any argument replaces the resource and deploys again, so use `triggers` to redeploy when something else changes. Destroying it does not stop or remove the deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_service_deploy" "example" {
  service_id     = railway_service.example.id
  environment_id = railway_environment.example.id

  # Deploy again whenever one of these changes.
  triggers = {
    start_command = railway_service.example.start_command
    branch        = railway_service.example.source_repo_branch
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment to deploy in.
- `service_id` (String) Identifier of the service to deploy.

### Optional

- `commit_sha` (String) Commit to deploy. Defaults to the latest commit of the connected source.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that cause a new deploy when changed, e.g. attributes of the service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the deployment.
